_comment: Quaternius Universal Animation Library (CC0), as converted by ozz-animation 0.17
(third_party/ozz-animation/media/bin/quaternius). This file says WHICH FILE backs a
logical clip; code says which logical clip a gameplay state plays. Renaming or
reauthoring a clip is a change here, not a code change.
No _RM variants are shipped: game/ owns movement in ticks, so root motion is
deliberately excluded and the sim's authored window defines timing.
A clip is a bare filename, or an object when it carries metadata. 'pivot' is
the normalized point where the clip's action culminates: a swing's wind-up
plays [0, pivot] and its recovery plays [pivot, 1], so the impact frame lands
on the exact tick the sim resolves damage. Absent, it defaults to 1.0.
